rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a staircase or flight of stairs.

example.english: Be careful, that stair is slippery.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 go2 tiu4 lau4 tai1 hou2 sin3

rows.note: Use this for one individual step or tread within a staircase, rather than the whole staircase.

example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 ni1 go3 tai1 kap1 hou2 sin3
